name: twombly-canvas
description: Get feedback, huddle, and iterate with your team on a canvas beside your agent.

interface.longDescription: Get feedback, huddle, and iterate with your team on a canvas beside your agent.
defaultPrompt: Put our signup flow on Twombly so I can review every step side by side.
Make three versions of the pricing page and lay them out on a canvas.
Keep what I tuned on the selected frame.

positive.prompt: Create a private online canvas called Field guide.
positive.expected_behavior: A new empty canvas is opened. Link sharing stays private.

positive.prompt: Put Explore and Saved side by side as two interactive frames.
positive.expected_behavior: Both named frames appear in a single row.

positive.prompt: List the frames on this canvas.
positive.expected_behavior: Explore and Saved appear with their frame identifiers.

positive.prompt: Change the Explore heading to Coastal walks and update that frame.
positive.expected_behavior: Explore keeps its identifier and position. Saved remains intact.

positive.prompt: Read the comments on this new canvas.
positive.expected_behavior: An empty canvas returns no comments. A canvas with feedback returns its threads.

negative.prompt: Open the canvas with ID nonexistentcanvas.
negative.expected_behavior: Report that the canvas cannot be opened. Do not create a replacement.

negative.prompt: Update frame ID nonexistentframe on Field guide with a new index.html containing only a heading.
negative.expected_behavior: Report that the target does not exist. Leave existing frames intact.

negative.prompt: Explain what a CSS media query does.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the concept without creating or modifying a canvas.

publication.release_notes: Create a private online canvas, compare frames, and send feedback in chat.
